**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Serialize state writes to avoid dropping feedback**

When a debounced `/api/:key/state` write overlaps with `/api/:key/prompts`, layout warnings, or ending a session, this method reads a full `state.json` snapshot and later writes it back with only `session.state` changed. Because artifacts are now encouraged to call `setState` on each control change, that background write can clobber prompts, layout warnings, or status updates written after this read, causing queued human feedback to disappear from `state.json`. Please serialize these mutations or merge against the latest session immediately before writing.
